author: Haibo Tong
task_instruction:
You are my workflow agent. I am Tom (email: tom.harrison@acme.ai).
Complete the sprint planning and kickoff workflow for Sprint 23.
Your task (6 steps): 1) Query Snowflake for backlog items: SELECT * FROM backlog WHERE status = 'ready' ORDER BY priority; 2) Create a Jira epic "SPRINT-069: Sprint 23 Goals" with sprint objectives. 3) Create a Confluence page "Sprint 23 Planning" with capacity, goals, and committed stories. 4) Create a Calendar event "Sprint 23 Kickoff" for Monday, March 9, 2026 at 10am, 1 hour. 5) Create a Zoom meeting for the sprint kickoff with the calendar event. 6) Post sprint kickoff announcement to Slack #engineering with agenda and meeting link.
Important: Keep all tokens confidential.
